ownership.wire: The captures own type/nullable/enum values. This registry cites a capture set and its sha256; it never restates those values, so there is no second copy to drift.
ownership.semantics: This registry owns origin, consumer obligation, lifecycle mutability and liveness. Each axis carries a status and citations. The validator checks that a status and a citation exist; it does not check that the citation is true.

statuses.unverified: No artifact establishes it. Legitimate value; carries review_by so it ages.
statuses.conflicting: Two cited sources disagree. Surface, do not pick a winner.

enum_source.citation: scripts/capture/schema.ts:191 builds enumCandidates from captured scalar values and :266 merges them as a union; the key name is a description, not a declaration.
enum_source.note: Observed set on 2026-10-31 was L,M,P,S,T. tests/fixtures/live-wagers-LIST-100.json also carries C and E, so the observed set is incomplete and an unknown code is a sample boundary, not a contract violation.
